scripts.deadcode: cd .. && uv run --group deadcode --group lint python3 scripts/deadcode.py
scripts.test:all: tsc --noEmit && vitest run --coverage --exclude '**/.stryker-tmp*/**' && cd .. && uv run ruff check . && uv run --group test pytest -q --cov --cov-report=term --cov-report=html
scripts.mutation:all: stryker run && cd .. && uv run --group test --group mutation mutmut run && uv run --group test --group mutation mutmut results
